outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single representative H&E image and corresponding spatial transcriptomic plots from one lung section (referenced from Fig 3A); no quantification, averaging, or statistical comparison is presented, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: The staining was repeated with lung sections from different mice (n = 2–3, biological replicates).
outputs.explanation: Panel B shows representative RNAscope/H&E images with no summary statistics or quantification; the caption explicitly reports n = 2–3 biological replicates (different mice), which is acceptable for representative image data even though the minimum is 2.

replicate_statements: Tmprss11b transcript abundance in LUSC patient tumors (n = 500) relative to LUAD tumors (n = 512)
outputs.explanation: Panel C presents a statistical comparison (Welch's t test) of TMPRSS11B expression between LUAD and LUSC patient tumors, with both the number (n = 500 and n = 512) and type (patient tumors) of replicates clearly reported.

replicate_statements: Plot represents mean ± SD; n = 3 (technical replicates) per group
The experiment was repeated two times to confirm the observations.
outputs.explanation: Panel D shows a bar plot of mean ± SD with individual data points and an ANOVA statistical test; the caption reports n = 3 technical replicates per group, satisfying both the number and type requirements and exceeding the minimum of 2.
